patch_description: Keep five temporary conversions on detection, then convert two neutrals on each of the next three updates. This tests whether repeated sampling around the evolving shared best improves recovery beyond a single burst, while preserving three ordinary PSO moves per subsequent update. Afterward, all neutrals resume PSO. The has_detected_change guard prevents triggering during initial swarm development. Additional sampling could also disrupt convergence; the supplied feedback does not establish that this extension will improve performance.
